Basket.

dcterms:subject: New Corella"
dcterms:description: "Rattan carrying case weatherproofed with oil and ornamented with bamboo. This item is a tall rounded rectangular case that is dark brown with lighter brown zigzags vertical lines and horizontal lines around it's opening. A lid is attached and there are straps of leather as well."

"This is a small basket made of light and dark brown fibers that are alternated in the weaving. The base is rectangular and the mouth is round rimmed by light brown fibers in a slightly different weave. The basket is rather pliable."

dcterms:subject: Filipino
dcterms:description: One large basket made of the mid-ribs of coconut leaves. Round. Sides woven. Bottom radiating overlaid sections.
Round basket made of mid rib of coconut leaf.
"One round shallow basket made of mid-ribs of coconut leaves. The basket has a double-thickness reinforced base and is of a relatively open weave overall."

One woven reed tray for winnowing rice. The base is woven in a herringbone design with a thick band at the rim; all of the basket is a light tan natural color except for a darker brown narrow strip binding at the very top of the rim.

"1 deep circular basket. Made of linear leaves of pandanus? Decorated with multicolored cotton strips. Tapes down to bottom. Leaves on outer surface painted black. Bottom frame covered with scraps of colorful cotton textile. Above this are two bands of decoration made from shaped and woven fibers. Above this is a row of pyramids and step motifs of fiber with interior of pyramids filled with textile. Under top rim is a band of woven fiber then a series of geometric designs of fiber. Some of these are filled with cotton textile."
Fish container of rattan and nito. Decorated with alternating dark and light bands.
"Large market basket of bamboo rattan and lupis. The basket is supported by four thick bamboo legs and designed to sit on the ground."

dcterms:subject: Baco River; "
dcterms:description: Mangyan         "Carrying basket of dukmoy nito rattan. Used for fruits and Vegetables."
"One work basket with coconut midrib. Woven reed round with greater diameter at opening than base. Knotted bands at rim and articulation of base/walls."

dcterms:subject: Filipino
dcterms:description: Fish basket of rattan with cordage carrying strap. Original number Coo5772.

Shell basket of bamboo and rattan. This basket is woven of very dark organic material. It has a rectangular base and cylindrical body. A series of loops around the opening of the basket form handles and a hinge by which a lid of the same make is attached.

"1 rice basket of bamboo and rattan. This basket has a rectangular base of rigid material that is tied to the main part of the basket. At the top the basket opening is round and ringed with a piece of bamboo to help hold its shape."
"1 utility basket of banban rattan nito-abaca. Used for thread eggs

"One telescoping traveling basket made of bamboo and rattan. This basket is carried under the arm by a rope strap that also serves to hold together the lid and the base. The overall shape is a rectangular base that woven up into an oblong solid with a rectangular top. The lid is as tall as the base allowing the basket to expand in height as it is filled. The color is natural with narrow diagonal stripes woven into the body of the lid."
Corn measure of rattan. Used for both measuring and handling. Small rounded woven basket.
"Buyo basket-bamboo rattan dappig Used by Ifudgaos"

dcterms:subject: Ifugao
dcterms:description: "One Buyo basket of bamboo rattan and dappig. Used by the Ifugaos. Tall basket with round opening and square bottom changes shape halfway. Upper section has tight weave (rattan) and lower was looe weave. The rim is made of rattan wrapped bamboo. A cord of braided fiber is attached at two points on opposite sides and hangs in the middle. Tag says: ""Obtained at batangas. It has been used. One is put on each end of a pole and carried on the shoulders."" fiber cord was probably used for hanging on pole."
One work basket of buri for holding abaca fibers in preparation for weaving.

dcterms:subject: Lepanto"
dcterms:description: "Bamboo rice basket for uncooked rice. This basket has a thick rectangular frame at the base thick woven pieces form a frame along the sides and there is a round frame piece at the mouth of the basket. The basket bulges in the middle and is constricted at the mouth and base. There are four handles formed by separating the frame pieces along the sides allowing a gap. The basket is rather dark and it appears that the fibers have been treated with something to make them darker."
One sewing basket of bamboo and rattan. Wide mesh hexagonal bottom. Round opening. Open weave. Forms patterns that look like stars of David. Bamboo around rim.

dcterms:subject: Philippines"
dcterms:description: Utility basket of bamboo and rattan. This basket has a rectangular base and round opening on top rimmed with a thick strip of bamboo.

"1 rice basket of bamboo rattan and bark. This basket has a rectangular base of rigid material that is tied to the main part of the basket. At the top the basket opening is round and ringed with a piece of bamboo to help hold its shape."
"Utility basket of bamboo rattan and nito. The basket is round and made of an open weave. A handle extends over the basket and accounts for over half the artifact height."

dcterms:subject: Tinguian
dcterms:description: "Bamboo rice basket from Tinguian culture. The basket sits on a rectangular base and has a general bowl shape and a wide round opening at top. The majority of the basket is light brown but a darker brown decoration has been achieved by weaving dark bands horizontally and vertically."

dcterms:subject: Camarines"
dcterms:description: Hexagonal basket woven with hexagonal pattern and with undulating top.

dcterms:subject: Legaspi"
dcterms:description: Bicol           "One cylindrical sewing basket made of caragumoy. The base is roughly square but the body is round and straight forming a cylinder shape. Used by the Bicol."

dcterms:subject: Lepanto"
dcterms:description: Rice basket of bamboo for uncooked rice.

dcterms:subject: Mindoro"
dcterms:description: "1 Abaca contained of nipa and rattan. Used to hold abaca fibers. Open-weave basket with hexagonal base and round top."

dcterms:subject: Tagalog
dcterms:description: Market basket of rattan. The basket is round with a slightly conical bottom and a very wide opening ringed with rigid bamboo.
One pack holder of rattan. Shaped like a purse. Main body has rattan woven in fancy interlocked knots. Handle made of rattan braid. Round bottom with star inside.

dcterms:subject: Manobo
dcterms:description: "Utility basket of rattan and bamboo. Woven rattan basket round opening hexagonal bottom. There is a length of bamboo wrapped around the basket. This is wrapped over with rattan."
Small covered (no cover present) basket of rattan and bamboo. Used for flowers.
1 square open weave basket of bamboo with small circular opening on top. A fish trap (?)
"One rattan tray. The overall shape is round and shallow with the base woven in a herringbone pattern. At the rim there is a thicker binding strip held in place by narrow lacing."
Large round basket with unfinished top. Frame pieces extend approximately 7 cm above woven portion. Filled with spools of cotton thread and wool yarn.
Small round basket of woven fiber. Has rounded bottom and thus does not stand.
bask or hat of twilled basketry. Round. No bottom. Open at both ends. One opening is narrow while other is wide.

"One grass basket from the Philippines. The bas of the basket is flat and the sides angle out to form a truncated cone shape. Made of coils of grass sewn together with two-ply thread the majority of the basket is natural interspersed with horizontal rings of green and red from the center of the base to the top. At the very center of the base is a hole approximately 1.5cm in diameter."
"1 bamboo ring. One tan strip of bamboo bent into a circle and with the edges knotted together."

"1 man's travel basket. Called ""nead basket"" made with water proof lejuco covering. Basket has a rectangular base made of a wide rigid strip of organic material. Body of the basket is made of basketry in a tightly woven zigzag pattern. A flap comes over the top of the basket opening to cover it and is attached to two straps of similar woven basketry. Another flap is attached to the cover flap and this outer flap is made of woven basketry covered with a shaggy plant material reminiscent of porcupine quills or grass. This shaggy material covers one entire side of the basket as well as the closure flap."

Dialect - Tampipi. Bamboo and rattan. No. E-105. Price $.40 Obtained at San Fernando."" Box - deep rectangular box made of interwoven rattan in zigzag pattern. Top bottom and middle of sides are reinforced with bamboo. Each corner also has a reinforcement of a 1/2 (cut vertically) tube of bamboo. The cut is not complete  and rattan inside."

"Basket. Round topped basket with square base. Woven rattan fiber with bamboo around the rim. Two small rattan handles. Cotton string hangs inside from one end to other. Attached card reads: ""Basket has been used for one year. It is used by all classes for holding various articles."""

dcterms:subject: Igorot
dcterms:description: This head basket is composed of 2 small pouches to which rows of grasses and needles have been attached at the back. The main part of the basket consists of a long pouch of finely woven rattan. This pouch is rectangular. At the top of the pouch a V-shaped slit is left open. The sides and bottom of the front pouch are made out of plant fiber netting.

dcterms:spatial: Asia-Southeast Asia-Philippines--; Northern Luzon; Benguet and Bontoc Provinces
dcterms:subject: Igorot
dcterms:description: This is a basket of finely woven rattan. At the top a flap is attached to one side of the basket and extends over the opening. The top of the basket is shaped on both sides like the top half of a hexagon. Two long braided cords of rattan are attached to the opening to be used as possible shoulder straps. The flap over the front is thatched with rows of loose fiber (needles?). The base of the basket is a rectangular wooden frame.

dcterms:spatial: Asia-Southeast Asia-Philippines--; Northern Luzon; Benguet and Bontoc Provinces

dcterms:description: "Child's comote. A woven rattan handle is attached at opposite ends by a fiber braid."
